critical_code_review_comments: routers/invoices.py invoice_payments (line ~278): de-dup logic compares (linked_sc_payment_invoice_id == invoice_id) AND amount AND date. If a user edits the previous_sc_payment.date or amount, the auto-mirrored tx is re-synced first via _sync_invoice_sc_payment_transaction so the comparison still holds. Verified via test_auto_mirrored_tx_is_deduped. Good.

routers/invoices.py invoice_payments: hard-codes mode='bank_transfer' for income transactions because mode isn't on the tx schema. Cosmetic — acceptable for now since auto-mirrored entry IS de-duped, but if users start logging income transactions manually, mode label won't reflect reality. Consider adding a 'mode' field to transactions when business rules need it.

Dashboard refactor: PALETTES re-export pattern (in dashboardUtils.js -> imported in Dashboard.jsx) works but adds coupling. If any future component depends on PALETTES through a tree-shaken import, ensure it stays exported.

OverviewLists.jsx StudentList uses non-unique key for list items (only name, not id). Triggers React duplicate-key warning. Two students with the same name will collapse visually — recommend keying by student.id.

invoicePdf.js falls back to previous_sc_payment when `payments` arg is empty for SC invoices — backend /payments endpoint already returns it, so primary flow is consistent. The fallback is a safety net for clients that haven't been updated to fetch payments first.
clientStatementPdf.js renders different layouts for staff vs non-staff based on a single is_staff flag. Filename construction in ClientDetail.jsx is good.
PDF filename uses YYYY-MM-DD of generation date (today), not statement period — this matches the spec but worth documenting in product copy.
